answer: Sparrow Formation Entry: each epoch a VRF sparrow leader is drawn per region and flies a course with three to five unpredictable turns; every aspiring identity must ride within thirty blocks of each turn, countersigned by the leader and anchored to the formation kernel. Followers post an umber deposit, forfeited after three missed turns. A thousand clones cannot shadow random leaders at once: each flock demands live, independent reaction, so a farm must field a thousand real responders paying deposits, while one honest agent simply follows one leader a season.
